note: T7 Influence seasons and top-N prizes. Season length is balance.season_city_days, never stored here. Prize period length is derived from prize_periods_per_season. Prize assets are the six district tickers, never CORP. Payout is live after the C11 recount (season_prizes_live=1); rank was already v1.

influence_intensity_exp_bps.why: Degree 1 of intensity. v1 is a product of four intensities, not a weighted sum tuned by eye

influence_stability_exp_bps.why: Degree 1 of stability. A dead day zeroes the product; an exponent other than identity is a v1 lint error

influence_efficiency_exp_bps.why: Degree 1 of efficiency versus the canonical 10000 neutral, not versus a server mean

influence_coverage_exp_bps.why: Degree 1 of playable coverage. Zero opened districts is identity, not a penalty for missing a stake

prize_top_n.why: HUD is a simple table, not a twenty-row board. Zipf n equals this count, never a hand list of shares

prize_curve_alpha_bps.why: Alpha 1: weight is BPS//k. Geometric 1/2 is winner-take-all; equal shares are a ten-sybil grab

prize_periods_per_season.why: Divisor of season_city_days, not a second length. Exact divide gives three prize periods; storing 30 would fork T2 on the first season edit

season_qualify_bps.why: Twenty percent of the prize period must have I_day > 0. A clone on day 29 of the period is not backfilled

prize_require_live_stake.why: At least one playable_v1 stake still live at settlement. Token thresholds are the frozen S_min snapshot

season_prizes_live.why: C11 recount: rank stays, $CORP payout is on. Flipping this without rules_version 0.19.0 is yield

prize_live_min_rules_minor.why: Minor floor of the last prize-formula recount (0.19.0). v1.1 raises rules_version without moving this floor (D-G-3); live=1 below it would mint CORP as yield

prize_creator_tax_share_bps.why: Increment of the 2% tax, not the body. Body still feeds payroll; this half is the monthly stock basket plus studio ETH. Raising it without raising the headline rate starves the fund

prize_cork_share_bps.why: Fund cork is a recovery channel for payroll, not a prize tap

prize_nft_share_bps.why: G6 fixed the crane at zero (D-G-9). NFT proceeds close the inference bill; a prize share would promise yield the protocol cannot hold

prize_hop_haircut_bps.why: Prize hop is unused: month stocks are bought by the conveyor, not at spend. Do not copy fragment_hop_haircut_bps

leaderboard_scope.why: One wallet one slot: max of that wallet's cities, not a sum that rebuilds the whale from six towns

derived.zipf_weights: BPS // k for k = 1..n at alpha = 10000
derived.zipf_payout_witness: floor Zipf on the BPS pool at prize_top_n; dust stays
derived.influence_witnesses: optimizer_ref, lazy_whale, active_whale, last_day_clone from existing params
derived.prize_season_budget: monthly DEX turnover × leaderboard leg (0.3%); spend_protocol is 0 and never funds prizes
derived.sybil_cost_vs_rank10: qualify time, reference deposit, stake target vs rank-10 payout at N cities
derived.settle_hour: efficiency_recalc_hour, first hour of a new prize period
derived.prize_asset: six district tickers joined, never CORP and never Capital (R-M-3 inverted)
derived.prize_assets: districts[].ticker in file order, never CORP, never a hand list, never playable_v1
derived.prize_share_cap_over_contribution_bps: smallest k so T3 rank-1 Zipf at N=2 is unclipped; never stored
derived.prize_kettles: farm = DEX active-work leg × 14d tickets; month = DEX leaderboard leg × period Zipf; unmixed
derived.basket_zipf_witness: N=1 takes each pool; N=10 harmonic per asset; empty ticker does not block
derived.share_cap_witness: optimizer rank-1 unclipped; ten farm clones at 0.1% contrib are clipped
